title: Buhe
logline: On Buhe, a mother's bread leaves the house, and a blessing comes back with the song.
audience: Ethiopians and the Habesha diaspora, roughly 18 to 35, watching short vertical video on their phones, plus curious viewers who have never seen Buhe.
intent: Viewers should feel the warmth of a street where neighbours feed each other and bless each other, and think either 'I miss this' or 'I want to see this'.
style_block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft film grain, visible brush texture, ember-orange firelight against deep indigo dusk, gentle and slightly nostalgic mood, no text, no logos, no photorealistic faces.
negative_style: photorealistic faces, text, letters, watermark, logo, modern cars, plastic objects

characters.mother: an illustrated Ethiopian mother in a white cotton shawl with a woven coloured border, hair wrapped, seen mostly from behind, in profile, or as hands only; an invented character, not a portrait of any real person
characters.boys: a group of illustrated boys in colourful clothes carrying long thin sticks, shown as warm silhouettes lit by firelight, faces softly stylised and never realistic

narrator.style: Say warmly, slowly and unhurried, like an adult remembering a childhood evening

neighbor.style: Say with a warm, friendly greeting

elders.style: Say as an older person giving a gentle blessing

shots.reason: Establishes where and when: a home at first light on the day of Buhe, before anything has happened.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of an Ethiopian family courtyard at first light, thin smoke rising from a clay baking pan over an open fire, a wooden stool and a woven basket, corrugated-roof houses around, cool blue-grey dawn with a warm glow at the fire.
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke drifts slowly upward and the camera eases forward very slowly.

shots.reason: Introduces the mother's craft and the film's heart: the bread begins as work done by hand.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a woman's hands kneading pale dough on a low wooden board, flour dust in soft window light, white cotton sleeve with a woven border, no face visible.
shots.motion_prompt: The hands knead slowly; the camera stays locked off.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_am: ጎህ ሳይቀድ እናቴ ሊጡን ማቡካት ጀምራለች።
narration.text_en: Before dawn, my mother is already kneading.

shots.reason: Shows the two objects that make this bread Buhe's: the koba wrapping and the clay baking pan. It teaches a foreign viewer what mulmul is.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of round dough loaves wrapped in broad green leaves resting on a clay baking pan above glowing embers, warm steam, a hand placing one more loaf.
shots.motion_prompt: A wisp of steam rises and the camera pushes in slightly.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_am: ሊጡን በኮባ ጠቅልላ በሸክላ ምጣድ ትጋግራለች። ሙልሙል፤ ለቡሄ ብቻ የሚጋገር ዳቦ።
narration.text_en: She wraps the dough in koba leaves and bakes it on the clay pan. Mulmul, bread made only for Buhe.

shots.reason: Lets the smell of the day carry the story forward: the bread is ready and the whole neighbourhood knows.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of a woven basket full of warm golden round loaves on a doorstep, steam curling, smoky afternoon light, a narrow lane behind.
shots.motion_prompt: Steam curls upward and the camera drifts slowly to the right.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_am: ከሰዓት በኋላ መንደሩ በዳቦና በጭስ ሽታ ይሞላል።
narration.text_en: By afternoon, the whole neighbourhood smells of bread and smoke.

shots.reason: The first half of the exchange the film is about: the bread leaves the house before anything comes back.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a small illustrated child seen from behind, carrying a cloth bundle of bread down a narrow lane between houses, long afternoon shadows.
shots.motion_prompt: The child walks slowly away from the camera; the camera follows gently.

shots.reason: The human moment: the greeting that turns a gift into community.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of an illustrated neighbour woman in a doorway receiving a bundle of bread with both hands, smiling warmly, lane behind her, face softly stylised and turned slightly away.
shots.motion_prompt: She accepts the bundle and nods; the camera stays still.

shots.reason: Explains the chibo: the fire is the visual climax and needs a build-up before it is lit.
shots.image_prompt: At dusk, a bundle of long dry sticks tied together and standing upright in the middle of a dirt yard, dark silhouettes of family members gathering around it, deep indigo sky.
shots.motion_prompt: Silhouettes gather slowly; the camera pushes in a little.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_am: ምሽት ላይ እንጨቱ ተሰብስቦ ጭቦው ይለኮሳል።
narration.text_en: At dusk, the sticks are gathered and the chibo is lit.

shots.reason: The film's visual peak: the light spreads outward from the fire, which is also what the tradition means.
shots.image_prompt: The tied bundle of sticks catching fire, flames rising and sparks drifting upward, orange light spreading over silhouetted figures.
shots.motion_prompt: Flames flicker and sparks rise; the camera slowly pulls back.

shots.reason: The second half of the exchange: bread goes out and a blessing in song comes back. This is the film's turn.
shots.image_prompt: A group of boys as warm orange silhouettes holding long thin sticks, singing with open mouths, lit only by firelight, standing at a house gate.
shots.motion_prompt: The boys sway and strike their sticks on the ground; the camera stays still.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_am: ከዚያም ድምፃቸው ይሰማል፤ ልጆች ከቤት ወደ ቤት በበትራቸው መሬቱን እየመቱ ይመጣሉ። በራችን ላይ ቆሜ ሙልሙል እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ እነሱም ለእኛ የተለየውን የዘፈኑን ክፍል ይዘምራሉ።
narration.text_en: Then I hear them: boys going from house to house, striking the ground with their sticks. I stand at our gate and give them mulmul, and they sing back the part of the song that is ours.

sfx: sticks striking the ground in rhythm

shots.reason: The closing image the family asked for: everyone and the fire in one frame. The elders' blessing is the last word.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a whole street: family members, children and the burning chibo together in warm firelight under a deep indigo sky, houses with glowing doorways.
shots.motion_prompt: The camera pulls back slowly to reveal the whole street.

narration.speaker: elders
narration.text_en: May we reach this day again, year after year!

cues.caption: Gentle warm acoustic texture, soft plucked strings and a light hand drum, slow and nostalgic, no strong lead melody, leaves room for a spoken voice, instrumental.

song_experiment.plan: Plan A: ACE-Step sings a short Amharic chorus. Plan B: Gemini TTS speaks it as a rhythmic chant over stick beats and clapping. Plan C: percussion and clapping only. Needs verse text supplied by the author; nothing is written yet.
